segments.name: Analog
segments.note: Analog chips — the core business, sensing and managing power and signals in industrial, automotive and data-center equipment; up 32% YoY and 81% of total revenue, with $2,505M of operating profit.

segments.name: Embedded Processing
segments.note: Processors built into products to control them; up 21% YoY, with $227M of operating profit.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Everything else, including calculators and custom products; down 6% YoY, with $142M of operating profit including acquisition and restructuring items.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: R&D — designing new analog and embedded chips; up from $518M a year ago, growing far slower than revenue.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Sales, marketing and the back office (SG&A); up from $457M a year ago.

opex.name: Acquisition charges
opex.note: Charges tied to acquisitions; restructuring charges/other were $0 this quarter, versus $85M a year ago.

oneTimers: Acquisition charges were $7M in the quarter and restructuring charges/other were $0 (versus $85M a year ago) — both are included in the $2,874M operating profit.
Earnings per share included a 1-cent reduction that was not in the company's original guidance, as stated in the release.
verdict: Texas Instruments' revenue rose 28% to $6.06B as Analog sales surged 32%, lifting net income 78% to $2.43B.
otherDetail: Other income (expense), net was $72M, less $141M of interest and debt expense — a net $69M expense outside operations.
footerNote: Segment operating profit: Analog $2,505M, Embedded Processing $227M, Other $142M.
follow100Note: Analog takes $81.11 of every $100 Texas Instruments takes in. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Analog is driving the quarter
takeaways.text: Analog revenue hit $4,911M, up 32% YoY — 81% of all revenue — with $2,505M of operating profit. Embedded Processing also grew 21% to $858M.

takeaways.title: Margins expanded sharply
takeaways.text: Gross profit was $3,887M, or 64.2% of revenue, up from 57.4% a year ago, because revenue grew 28% while cost of revenue rose only about 7%.

takeaways.title: Cash generation stayed very strong
takeaways.text: Cash flow from operations was $3,419M in Q3 and free cash flow (operations less capital spending, plus any CHIPS Act incentives) was $2,956M, after $463M of capital expenditures.
